verdict.rationale: Restricting results to a domain is documented through the `site:` query operator (e.g. `site:github.com rust tutorials`). Goggles let developers boost or demote specific websites and domains, and are described as "custom reranking & result filtering," including controlling which sources ground LLM context. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hard domain exclusion (an exclude/discard rule or parameter, not just demotion), a dedicated include/exclude-domains API parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration.
